assumptions: USD million. Fictional Alder Vale Hospital. All 2025 amounts audited; administrative activity counts are not patient-level clinical outcomes. Comparable growth uses continuing facilities; acquisition contributions separated. No tax beyond provided.

evidence.text: [2024 annual report] Total inpatient revenue200, outpatient120. Continuing facilities account for all 320; no disposals. Inpatient discharges16,000, outpatient visits160,000. Direct cost220, overhead60, no separate segment cost.

[2025 audited p.18] Inpatient revenue250, outpatient150. Acquired clinic contribution inpatient20 and outpatient30, included since July1. Continuing inpatient discharges17,000, acquired discharges1,000. Continuing outpatient visits165,000, acquired visits35,000.

[Case-mix note] Continuing inpatient case weight index2024=1.10, 2025=1.20. The index is weighted relative resource complexity, not a quality score. No DRG-level revenue, outcome or case-specific costs.
[Costs] Total 2025 direct cost270, overhead75, depreciation20 separate. Interest12, tax5. Acquired clinic direct/overhead costs not separately provided.
[Payer note] 2025 earned net consideration400 already excludes negotiated discounts and final denials. Gross billed charges500; cash collections380. Opening receivable40; no writeoffs.
[Liquidity] CFO30, cash capex45, acquisition cash80 classified investing. FCF definition CFO minus ordinary cash capex, excludes acquisition.

[Preliminary presentation] Reports 2025 revenue growth25% as organic; uses total revenue400 divided by continuing inpatient discharges17k as inpatient price; calls case weight improvement proof of clinical quality.
[Audit instruction] No 2025 unique patient counts, acquisition costs by line, clinical mortality/readmissions or causal study. Do not infer unreported metrics.

qas.answer: Reported400 gồm50 doanh thu acquired clinic, còn base2024 chưa có. Continuing350 so320 mới cùng phạm vi.

qas.question: Có lấy gross charges500 làm earned revenue để tính margin?
qas.answer: Không. Net payer consideration400 đã trừ contractual discounts/denials; 500 là gross billing trước adjustment.

qas.question: Case-mix index tăng 1,10→1,20 có chứng minh điều trị tốt hơn?
qas.answer: Không. Index đo resource complexity, không outcome. Cần clinical indicators và risk adjustment.

qas.question: Có giải thích toàn bộ tăng inpatient revenue per discharge bằng tăng case mix?
qas.answer: Không. Còn tariff, service mix, reimbursement và timing; thiếu DRG-level data để phân rã.

qas.question: Có tính operating margin riêng acquired clinic từ contribution50?
qas.answer: Không. Không có direct cost, overhead, D&A phân bổ của clinic.

qas.question: Có coi discharges18k+outpatient visits200k là 218k unique patients?
qas.answer: Không. Visits và discharges là events, có thể cùng người nhiều lần; không có unique identifier.

qas.question: Có dự báo acquisition payback từ 50 recognized revenue và 80 acquisition cash?
qas.answer: Không. Revenue không phải incremental cash benefit; thiếu cost, cash collections, investment horizon và terminal value.

assumptions: USD million and million physical units. Fictional Saffron Route Freight. Annual freight revenue is earned principal consideration including fuel surcharge. Physical tonne-km measures load×distance, not vehicle km. Prior currency effects absent.

evidence.text: [2024 audited] Freight base revenue180, surcharge20; tonnes carried5m, tonne-km400m, vehicle km80m. Direct expense150 and overhead30. No other income.
[2025 audited] Freight base revenue210, fuel surcharge50. Tonnes carried5.5m, tonne-km500m, vehicle km100m, loaded vehicle km75m. Own all vehicle operations, no third-party brokerage.
[Cost breakdown] 2025 fuel expense85 vs 2024 fuel50. Nonfuel direct expense100 vs2024 100. Overhead35 vs30. No separate depreciation, interest or tax.
[Pricing note] Surcharge rates vary by lane, indexed quarterly to fuel prices; no per-lane price or distance mix. Base freight contracts renegotiated for some lanes; no counterfactual.
[Cash note] 2025 customer collections250, opening AR25, all earned billed, no writeoffs. Fuel cash paid80, opening fuel AP not provided.
[Metric] Average freight revenue per tonne-km uses all freight consideration divided by tonne-km; base yield excludes surcharge. Loaded vehicle utilization uses loaded/total vehicle km.
[Deck] Calls revenue growth30% growth in transported tonnage; calls tonne-km growth25% increase in number of trucks; uses surcharge50 as fuel profit.
[Disclosure] No truck count, liters purchased, driver hours, lane-level margin, commodity price/volume breakdown.

qas.question: Có suy ra số trucks tăng25% vì tonne-km tăng25%?
qas.answer: Không. Tonne-km phụ thuộc tonnes và distance; fleet count, utilization per truck chưa có.

qas.question: Có đo liters per loaded km?
qas.answer: Không. Fuel expense không cho liters, và thiếu fuel unit price.

qas.question: Có phân rã exact increase base revenue thành lane price/volume/mix?
qas.answer: Không. Aggregate tonnes và tonne-km không đủ; cần lane-specific prices and distances.

qas.question: Có tính closing fuel payable chỉ dùng expense85−cash80?
qas.answer: Không. 5 chỉ possible movement; opening fuel AP và adjustment thiếu.

assumptions: USD million; fictional Fir Wave Mobile. Registered SIMs, active paying SIMs, unique people and household coverage are distinct. Definitions in signed FY report take priority over marketing material.

evidence.text: [2024 audited] Service revenue240, device sales60. Average active paying SIMs1.5m, ending active1.6m. Reported coverage of population82%, denominator fixed at 10m modeled residents.

[2025 audited] Service revenue300, device sales90, wholesale network revenue30 (new category); average active paying SIMs1.8m, ending active2.0m. Registered SIMs3.1m. Same modeled population10m; coverage88%.
[ARPU policy] Monthly retail service ARPU excludes wholesale and devices; average paying SIMs, not registered/ending/unique persons. No acquisition, currency impact.
[Cost] Service and wholesale delivery expense170, device COGS70, sales/admin85, D&A35. No other operating costs. Interest15, tax8.
[Network] Cash network capex100, noncash vendor equipment20. Spectrum license renewal cash40 capitalized separately. CFO95. FCF after all cash capex defined CFO−network cash capex−spectrum cash.

[Operational] Coverage measures modeled residents in geographic signal footprint; capacity and actual usage not verified. Active subscriber counts are SIMs, one person may own multiple. No unique user registry.
[Marketing deck] Says 88% national market share based on coverage and 3.1m paying customers based on registered SIMs. Uses total revenue420/ending active2m/12 as ARPU.
[Disclosure] No competitors' customer counts, actual household broadband adoption, monthly churn, usage per user, or incremental spectrum forecast.
